candidate.definition_en: Something, typically money, that is owed or due.
candidate.explanation_ar: الديون، الفلوس اللي عليك ولازم ترجعها لحد تاني.

senses.definition_en: A sum of money that is owed or due to be paid back.
senses.definition_ar: مبلغ من المال مستحق الدفع لشخص أو جهة أخرى.
examples: The company is trying to reduce its debt.
National debt has reached an all-time high.

senses.definition_en: The state of owing money or an obligation.
senses.definition_ar: حالة المديونية أو الالتزام بدفع المال أو رد الجميل.
examples: She is in debt to the bank.
The company is trying to reduce its debt.
She is in debt to the bank.
National debt has reached an all-time high.
candidate.mnemonic: حرف الـ 'b' ساكت مبيتنطقش، زي ما أنت ساكت لما حد يطلب منك سداد الـ 'Debt' 'الدين'.
